highlights: Soundcore by Anker Mini 3 Pro Portable Waterproof Bluetooth Speaker
Experience Sound Like Never Before with Anker Soundcore Mini 3 Pro

360° Audio Fully Submerge Yourself in Each Beat: With the Anker Soundcore Mini 3 Pro, you can enter a world of immersive audio. 360° sound is produced by its creative design, enveloping the entire space with rich, detailed sounds.
"Soundcore by Anker Mini 3 Pro is a perfect pocket portable bluetooth speaker! Get 360° of ear-dazzling audio squeezed into something smaller than a coffee cup.
With a 15-hour battery life on a single charge and IPX7 waterproof, who says beach and pool parties can't get as wild as you want?
It's your sound, your rules, so connect the Mini 3 to the Soundcore app to turn it on, off, adjust the volume, change the sound profile, and much more.
A USB-C charging port is included for fast-charging with the latest technologies and Bluetooth 5.0 can keep your audio experience crystal clear with a strong connection.
